Docs.typeparam: The .NET type used in the EF model.

summary.para: Represents the mapping between a .NET type and a database type, where the .NET type used in the EF model is statically known.
This type is typically used by database providers (and other extensions). It is generally not used in application code.

remarks.para: Knowing the model CLR type statically allows the default instances to be created without reflection, which is required for NativeAOT compatibility.
See Implementation of database providers and extensions for more information and examples.
